content.intro: In Paraguay people greet each other warmly and use 'vos' instead of 'tú'. In this lesson you'll learn to say hello, introduce yourself, and ask where someone is from.

vocab.note: Casual greeting, used any time of day.
Voseo form (used in Paraguay instead of '¿cómo te llamas?').

vocab.gloss: a cold herbal drink; a Paraguayan social ritual
vocab.note: Often offered when meeting someone: 'Vamos a tomar un tereré' = Let's have a tereré.

exercises.prompt: Introduce yourself in Spanish: say your name and where you're from.
Ask someone what their name is and where they're from — use 'vos' forms.
Invite someone to have a tereré with you, in a full sentence.
